summary: A handoff was refused because the checkpoint moved between issuing the handle and consuming it, and two more outcome envelopes from the same misspelling window failed to join.

prior_learning.why: this change produced the timeout-semantics workaround that a later change retrieved; it retrieved nothing itself

refusal_or_degradation.what_happened: the checkpoint was revised between the handle being issued and being consumed, so the content digest no longer matched and the handoff was refused rather than carried
refusal_or_degradation.detected_by: the digest check on consume; a handle that validated anyway would have carried a receipt describing content that no longer existed, and nothing downstream could have detected it

refusal_or_degradation.what_happened: two further outcome envelopes from the same misspelled-kind window failed to join to their receipts
refusal_or_degradation.detected_by: the same by-hand comparison that found the first two
